title: Scary Things That Look Like Muscle Pain

hook.en: Most back, neck and shoulder pain is harmless. A few are not: cancer, infection, a fracture, a leaking artery, a heart attack. They can look exactly like a strained muscle. This lesson teaches the pattern that should make you stop and refer.
hook.ur: Zyada tar kamar, gardan aur kandhe ka dard bezarar hota hai. Kuch nahi hote: cancer, infection, fracture, phatti hui sharyaan, heart attack. Yeh bilkul kheenche hue muscle jaise lag sakte hain. Yeh lesson woh pattern sikhata hai jo aap ko rok kar refer karne par majboor kare.

goal.en: By the end, you'll sort pain into "behaves like a mechanical problem" or "does not", name the main serious causes by body system, use clusters of clues instead of single red flags, and say the right words to the patient when you refer.
goal.ur: End tak aap dard ko "mechanical jaisa" ya "mechanical nahi" mein baant sakenge, body system ke hisaab se bari wajahon ke naam lenge, akeli red flag ke bajaye clues ka cluster istemal karenge, aur refer karte waqt mareez se sahi alfaaz kahenge.

text.en: Muscle and joint pain has a **personality**. Mechanical pain changes with movement and position: worse with some postures, better with others, easier at rest. Serious pathology often has a different personality: **constant, unrelenting, not changed by position, worse at night, or arriving with the body as a whole unwell**. Your first job in every assessment is not to find the muscle. It is to ask: does this pain behave like a mechanical problem?
text.ur: Muscle aur joint ke dard ki ek **shakhsiyat** hoti hai. Mechanical dard harkat aur position se badalta hai: kuch postures mein zyada, kuch mein kam, aaram mein behtar. Serious bimari ki shakhsiyat aksar alag hoti hai: **musalsal, bina ruke, position se na badalne wala, raat mein zyada, ya poore jism ki kamzori ke saath**. Har assessment mein aap ka pehla kaam muscle dhoondna nahi. Poochna hai: kya yeh dard mechanical jaisa behave kar raha hai?

text.en: Think of a **smoke alarm**. It rings for burnt toast far more often than for a real fire, and nobody throws the alarm away because of that. Red flags work the same way: most are false alarms, but you never switch the alarm off. You check every time, quickly and calmly, and you are not embarrassed when it is toast.
text.ur: **Smoke alarm** sochein. Yeh jali hui roti par asli aag se kahin zyada bajta hai, aur is wajah se koi alarm phenkta nahi. Red flags bhi aise hain: zyada tar jhoothe alarm hote hain, lekin alarm kabhi band nahi karte. Har baar jaldi aur sukoon se check karein, aur roti nikle to sharminda na hon.

title.en: The main serious causes, by body system
title.ur: Bari wajahon ki fehrist, body system ke hisaab se

rows.en: Cancer (primary or spread)
rows.ur: Cancer

rows.en: Past cancer, age over 50 with new pain, unexplained weight loss, night pain not eased by rest
rows.ur: Pehle cancer, 50 se upar naya dard, wajah ke baghair wazan kam, aaram se na jaane wala raat ka dard

rows.en: Stop, refer for medical review the same week or sooner
rows.ur: Rukein, usi haftay ya jald medical review ke liye refer

rows.en: Infection (spine, joint, bone)
rows.ur: Infection

rows.en: Fever, recent infection or surgery, injections, diabetes or weak immunity, hot swollen joint, severe pain at any movement
rows.ur: Bukhaar, haal ki infection ya surgery, injections, diabetes ya kamzor immunity, garam soojha joint, har harkat par shadeed dard

rows.en: Urgent medical assessment, do not load or manipulate
rows.ur: Foran medical assessment, load ya manipulation nahi

rows.en: Fracture
rows.ur: Fracture

rows.en: Significant fall or crash, osteoporosis or long-term steroids, older age, sudden sharp pain, deformity
rows.ur: Bada girna ya hadsa, osteoporosis ya lambay arsay ke steroids, buzurgi, achanak tez dard, deformity

rows.en: Imaging first, protect the area
rows.ur: Pehle imaging, hissay ki hifazat

rows.en: Nerve compression, cauda equina
rows.ur: Nerve dabao, cauda equina

rows.en: Numbness between the legs, new bladder or bowel change, both legs weak, sexual numbness
rows.ur: Taangon ke beech sunn, peshab ya pakhaane ki nai tabdeeli, dono taangon mein kamzori, jinsi hissay mein sunn

rows.en: Emergency: same-day hospital
rows.ur: Emergency: usi din hospital

rows.en: Blood vessels
rows.ur: Khoon ki naliyan

rows.en: Tearing pain with a pulsing belly (aortic aneurysm), one swollen painful calf (clot), arm pain with cold pale hand
rows.ur: Phatne jaisa dard aur dhadakta pait (aortic aneurysm), ek soojhi dard bhari pindli (clot), thanda zard haath ke saath bazu ka dard

rows.en: Emergency or same-day medical review
rows.ur: Emergency ya usi din medical review

rows.en: Heart and lung
rows.ur: Dil aur phephre

rows.en: Pain with exertion, sweating, nausea, breathlessness, jaw or left arm spread, not changed by neck or shoulder movement
rows.ur: Mehnat par dard, paseena, matli, saans ki tangi, jabray ya bayen bazu mein phailna, gardan ya kandhay ki harkat se na badalna

rows.en: Stop, sit, vital signs, call for help
rows.ur: Rukein, bithayein, vital signs, madad bulayein

rows.en: Organs (kidney, gallbladder, pancreas, womb, bowel)
rows.ur: Andar ke aaza

rows.en: Pain unrelated to movement, with fever, vomiting, urine or period changes, or after eating
rows.ur: Harkat se unrelated dard, bukhaar, ulti, peshab ya mahwari ki tabdeeli, khane ke baad dard

rows.en: Refer to a doctor; explain why
rows.ur: Doctor ko refer karein; wajah samjhayein

title.ur: Chhoone se pehle 60 second ki screen

steps.title: Behaviour
steps.detail: Does movement or position change it? Is it constant, or worse at night even at rest? || Behaviour

steps.title: Body
steps.detail: Fever, chills, night sweats, unexplained weight loss, loss of appetite, feeling generally unwell. || Jism

steps.title: Background
steps.detail: Past cancer, osteoporosis, steroids, recent surgery or infection, injections, diabetes, immune problems, a major fall. || Pas-e-manzar

steps.title: Nerves and vessels
steps.detail: New numbness or weakness, bladder or bowel change, saddle numbness, swollen painful calf, cold pale limb, tearing pain. || Nerves aur naliyan

question.en: A 58-year-old woman has had mid-back pain for 5 weeks. It is worse at night, is not changed by position, and she has lost 5 kilograms without trying. She had breast cancer 6 years ago. What do you do?
question.ur: 58 saal ki khatoon ko 5 haftay se peeth ke beech ka dard hai. Raat ko zyada hai, position se nahi badalta, aur bina koshish ke 5 kilo wazan kam hua hai. 6 saal pehle breast cancer tha. Aap kya karein?

text.en: Stop, explain your concern and refer for a medical review within days
text.ur: Rukein, apni fikr samjhayein aur chand dinon mein medical review ke liye refer karein

feedback.en: Yes — past cancer, new night pain and weight loss form a cluster that needs a doctor.
feedback.ur: Haan — pehle cancer, naya raat ka dard aur wazan ka kam hona aisa cluster hai jisko doctor chahiye.

text.en: Apply heat and soft tissue release to the painful area
text.ur: Dard wale hissay par garmi aur soft tissue release

feedback.en: It could delay a diagnosis and could be unsafe.
feedback.ur: Isse diagnosis mein der ho sakti hai aur yeh ghair mehfooz ho sakta hai.

text.en: Start a posture and stretching programme and review in four weeks
text.ur: Posture aur stretching programme shuru karein aur chaar haftay baad review

feedback.en: That treats a muscle while the clues point elsewhere.
feedback.ur: Yeh muscle ka ilaaj hai jabke clues kahin aur ishara kar rahe hain.

text.en: **Trusting one red flag alone.** Many red flags are common in harmless back pain, so a single one has weak predictive power. A cluster, or a flag that fits the story (cancer history plus night pain plus weight loss), matters far more. The opposite mistake is just as bad: ignoring a strong cluster because the muscle test reproduced the pain.
text.ur: **Sirf ek red flag par bharosa.** Bohat si red flags aam bezarar kamar dard mein bhi hoti hain, isliye akeli ek ki predictive taqat kamzor hai. Cluster, ya aisi flag jo kahani se milti ho (cancer ka record, raat ka dard aur wazan ka kam hona), kahin zyada ahem hai. Ulta ghalat bhi utna hi bura hai: mazboot cluster ko nazar-andaaz karna sirf is liye ke muscle test ne dard dohra diya.

question.en: Which finding alone is MOST concerning for cauda equina syndrome?
question.ur: Cauda equina syndrome ke liye akeli kaun si cheez sab se zyada pareshan kun hai?

text.en: New numbness between the legs and difficulty passing urine
text.ur: Taangon ke beech naya sunn aur peshab karne mein mushkil

feedback.en: Yes — saddle numbness with bladder change is an emergency needing same-day hospital care.
feedback.ur: Haan — saddle sunn ke saath peshab ki tabdeeli emergency hai, usi din hospital chahiye.

text.en: Pain that is worse after a long walk and better when sitting
text.ur: Lambay chalne ke baad zyada, baithne par kam dard

text.en: Back stiffness in the morning that eases in 20 minutes
text.ur: Subah ki akdan jo 20 minute mein theek ho jaye

feedback.en: That is common in mechanical or inflammatory problems and is not an emergency pattern.
feedback.ur: Yeh mechanical ya inflammatory masle mein aam hai aur emergency pattern nahi.

question.en: A 41-year-old with poorly controlled diabetes has severe low back pain, a fever and a recent spinal injection. Any movement hurts. What is the safest plan?
question.ur: 41 saal ke mareez ko, jiski diabetes control mein nahi, shadeed kamar dard, bukhaar hai aur haal hi mein reedh ka injection laga hai. Har harkat dukhti hai. Sab se mehfooz plan kya hai?

text.en: Heat and massage, then review next week
text.ur: Garmi aur massage, phir agle haftay review

feedback.en: That treats a symptom while a serious cause is possible.
feedback.ur: Yeh symptom ka ilaaj hai jabke serious wajah mumkin hai.

text.en: Do not treat; arrange urgent medical assessment for possible spinal infection
text.ur: Ilaaj nahi; mumkin spinal infection ke liye urgent medical assessment karwayein

feedback.en: Yes — fever, diabetes, a recent injection and pain with every movement form an infection cluster.
feedback.ur: Haan — bukhaar, diabetes, haal ka injection aur har harkat par dard infection ka cluster banate hain.

text.ur: Harkat wapas laane ke liye halki mobilisation

feedback.en: Moving an infected spine is unsafe and delays treatment.
feedback.ur: Infection wali reedh ko hilana ghair mehfooz hai aur ilaaj mein der karta hai.

text.en: **Say it simply and calmly.** For example: "Your pain is behaving in a way that makes me want a doctor to check it first. This is most likely not serious, but some of what you describe is not typical muscle pain, and it is safer to be sure. I will write down what I found so the doctor has it." Never say the word cancer unless you are the right person to; never promise that it is nothing.
text.ur: **Saada aur sukoon se kahein.** Misaal: "Aap ka dard aise behave kar raha hai ke main chahta hoon pehle doctor check kar le. Zyada imkaan hai ke yeh serious nahi, lekin aap ki kuch baatein aam muscle dard jaisi nahi, aur yaqeen karna zyada mehfooz hai. Jo main ne dekha woh likh deta hoon taake doctor ke paas ho." Cancer ka lafz tab tak na kahein jab tak aap sahi shakhs na hon; yeh kabhi na kahein ke kuch nahi hai.

question.en: Why is a patient with a clear "muscle pain" test result still not safe to treat if the night pain and weight loss are there?
question.ur: Jab raat ka dard aur wazan ka kam hona maujood ho to saaf "muscle dard" wala test hone par bhi mareez ka ilaaj mehfooz kyun nahi?

answer.en: Because pain can be reproduced by pressing or moving almost any sore area, serious or not. A reproduced symptom proves that the area is tender; it does not prove the cause. The history and the cluster decide whether you treat or refer.
answer.ur: Kyunke taqreeban har dukhte hissay ko dabane ya hilane se dard dohraya ja sakta hai, chahe serious ho ya na ho. Dohraya hua symptom sirf yeh sabit karta hai ke hissa nazuk hai; wajah sabit nahi karta. Treat ya refer ka faisla history aur cluster karte hain.

beats.patient: A 66-year-old man has had right shoulder and arm pain for 3 days. It comes on when he walks fast uphill, with a feeling of pressure in the chest and sweating, and it eases after 10 minutes of rest. His neck and shoulder movements are normal and pressing the shoulder does not change it.
beats.assessment: The pattern is exertional, with chest pressure and sweating, and is relieved by rest, while neck and shoulder movement make no difference. This suggests angina rather than a shoulder problem.
beats.treatment: Do not treat the shoulder. Stop activity, take his pulse and blood pressure, explain your concern, and arrange urgent same-day medical assessment; call emergency services if the pain returns at rest or is severe.
beats.reassess: He is seen the same day, an ECG and further testing are arranged, and you document your findings in a note for the doctor. The shoulder can be reviewed later if it is still painful.

text.en: **When in doubt, refer, and never delay for a scan or a second opinion.** Never apply deep pressure, manipulation, heat or strong loading to a patient with a possible fracture, infection, clot, aneurysm or heart problem. If new bladder or bowel change, saddle numbness, a swollen painful calf, a tearing pain or chest pain with sweating appears, treat it as an emergency.
text.ur: **Shak ho to refer karein, aur scan ya doosri raay ka intezar karke der na karein.** Mumkin fracture, infection, clot, aneurysm ya dil ke masle wale mareez par gehra dabao, manipulation, garmi ya tez loading kabhi na karein. Agar naya peshab ya pakhaane ka masla, saddle sunn, soojhi dard bhari pindli, phatne jaisa dard ya paseenay ke saath seene ka dard aaye to ise emergency samjhein.

text.en: Single red flags are weak tests. A systematic review of red flags for fracture and malignancy in low back pain found that most individual flags have limited accuracy, and that combinations such as past cancer plus other clues were more useful. An international framework (Finucane 2020) therefore advises clinicians to weigh clusters, context and patient trajectory instead of ticking boxes.
text.ur: Akeli red flags kamzor tests hain. Kamar dard mein fracture aur malignancy ki red flags ke systematic review ne dikhaya ke zyada tar akeli flags ki accuracy mehdood hai, aur combinations jaise pehle cancer ke saath dusre clues zyada mufeed thay. Isliye international framework (Finucane 2020) kehta hai ke boxes tick karne ke bajaye clusters, context aur mareez ke raaste ko tolein.

text.en: **Behave, Body, Background, Blood and nerves.** Four B questions: does it behave mechanically, is the body unwell, does the background raise the risk, and are there nerve or blood vessel signs? Any "no" to the first with a "yes" to another: stop and think.
text.ur: **Behave, Body, Background, Blood aur nerves.** Chaar B sawal: kya mechanical behave karta hai, kya jism bemar hai, kya background khatra barhata hai, aur kya nerve ya khoon ki nali ke signs hain? Pehle par "nahi" aur kisi aur par "haan": rukein aur sochein.

summary.en: Ask first whether the pain behaves like a mechanical problem; if not, slow down and look for the cause.
summary.ur: Pehle poochhein ke dard mechanical jaisa behave karta hai ya nahi; agar nahi to ruk kar wajah dhoondein.

summary.en: Single red flags are weak; clusters and flags that fit the story are strong, and a strong cluster means stop and refer.
summary.ur: Akeli red flags kamzor hain; clusters aur kahani se milti flags mazboot hain, aur mazboot cluster ka matlab hai rukna aur refer karna.

summary.en: Refer calmly and clearly, document what you found, and never treat or manipulate while a serious cause is possible.
summary.ur: Sukoon aur wazahat se refer karein, jo dekha woh likhein, aur jab tak serious wajah mumkin ho ilaaj ya manipulation na karein.
